definition: Current measured exact-area stock at historical native sale prices. Sum(reference price/unit_type*exact area/3.3058*households). Known future construction excluded, unknown year retained.
coverage: Priced measured households divided by all known positive complex households, including unmapped area stock. Unknown household totals are outside the denominator. Closed10percentage-point ranges; below80 flag is exact.
support: 100households,10complexes,20% coverage and maximum20% complex value contribution; direct all-minus-normal complement checked; related Seoul normal rows withheld together where concentration exceeds20%.
precision: Amounts0.1trillion KRW; shares/changes0.1percent; no exact households, complex counts, IDs, native prices, pair numerators or denominators.
limitations: Not the full current or historical apartment wealth, not net equity or realized sale proceeds.
Surviving current stock and retrospective model; historical entry/removal and information vintages are not reconstructed.
Common-endpoint growth uses the same priced exact-area homes at both endpoints, with present-day weights; normal conditions change that cohort.
No aggregate confidence interval or causal decomposition.
